requirements.description: The user prefers properties near parks. Since this is a proximity expression, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 115. The 15-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. Energy class and proximity to parks are outside the reference columns and are ignored here. Turin is a city name, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set.
Energy class D or better is preferred. Includes all classes from D upward (A1-A4, B, C, D). Preference to be applied in ranking.
